segments.t: Last time in the Samsonov flat, Ivan and his children celebrated the veteran's speech at the televised mayoral debate that cleared their family name. After the children go to bed, Ivan is left alone in the room with Nina and eagerly talks about winning the election, but Nina looks at him with deep sadness and delivers a quiet shock. Let's listen to their conversation in Russian first.
Ты совсем не думаешь о семье.
Нет, ты делаешь всё ради себя.
Обыкновенный. Я больше так не могу.
Let's walk through how Nina drops a quiet bombshell on Ivan.
'The children went to bed. We're alone.' Ivan sits down beside Nina as the flat falls quiet.
'Are you happy about my grandfather?' He expects her to share his excitement about the debate victory.
'Now I will definitely win the election!' Ivan is riding high on public sympathy.
'Vanya, the election isn't what matters most.' Nina speaks softly without meeting his eyes.
'What does matter most? Tell me!' Ivan is genuinely perplexed by her cold tone.
Ты совсем не думаешь о семье.
'You don't think about the family at all.' She reminds him of weeks of brawls, police, and chaos.
'I do everything for the sake of the family!' The preposition requires the genitive case.
Нет, ты делаешь всё ради себя.
'No, you do everything for yourself.' Nina sees through his political ambitions.
'Nina, come on, wait! Everything will work out.' Ivan reaches out to take her hand.
'Listen, Vanya. I am very tired.' She pulls her hand away gently.
'Let's get a divorce.' The hortative particle combines with the perfective future verb to propose an action.
'What are you saying? What divorce?' Ivan freezes in complete disbelief.
Обыкновенный. Я больше так не могу.
'A regular one. I can't go on like this anymore.' Nina stands up, leaving Ivan stunned in the dim room. Now let's listen to the quiet, heartbreaking conversation again from start to finish.
Ты совсем не думаешь о семье.
Нет, ты делаешь всё ради себя.
Обыкновенный. Я больше так не могу.
Just as Ivan Samsonov's political star reaches its height with his grandfather vindicated, Nina realizes she can no longer bear the chaos of his campaign and asks for a divorce.
